mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_books ( title, contents, url, isbn, datetime, authors, publisher, translators, price, sale_price, thumbnail ) VALUES( #{title}, #{contents}, #{url}, #{isbn}, #{datetime}, #{authors}, #{publisher}, #{translators}, #{price}, #{sale_price}, #{thumbnail} )
mapper.select: SELECT idx, title, contents, url, isbn, datetime, authors, publisher, translators, price, sale_price, thumbnail FROM tb_books WHERE isbn like concat('%', #{isbn}, '%')

SELECT bl.idx, bl.b_idx, bl.status, bl.rent_s_date, bl.rent_e_date, bl.finish_date, b.title, b.contents, b.url, b.idx, b.datetime, b.authors, b.publisher, b.translators, b.price, b.sale_price, b.thumbnail FROM tb_book_list bl JOIN tb_books b ON b_idx = b.idx WHERE u_idx = #{idx}

SELECT count(*)
FROM tb_users WHERE email=#{email}
SELECT idx, name, email, target_book_count, grade FROM tb_users WHERE email=#{email} and password=#{password}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_users ( name, email, password, target_book_count ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{email}, #{password}, #{target_book_count} )
mapper.select: select bl.idx, bl.b_idx, bl.u_idx as u_id, bl.status, date_format(bl.rent_s_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as rent_s_date, date_format(bl.rent_e_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as rent_e_date, date_format(bl.finish_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as finish_date, datediff(now(), rent_e_date) as d_day, u.name, b.title from tb_book_list bl join tb_books b on (b.idx=bl.b_idx) join tb_users u on (u.idx=bl.u_idx) order by bl.idx desc
select (select count(*) from tb_users) as total_users, (select count(*) from tb_books) as total_books, (select count(*) from tb_book_list where status in(1, 2, 3)) as active_rents
select idx as u_idx, name, email, password, token, target_book_count, grade from tb_users order by idx desc
mapper.update: update tb_users set grade=#{grade} where idx = #{idx}
